audit.why: Poppy wins every stage per packet.levelChart and content win[]/whys[] — Q/E all-in at 1-3, Steadfast Presence cancels dashes through 4-6, and her frontline/W denies engage into late game.

audit.whatIsWrong: All 7 phases[N].side were the placeholder 'Skill' while win[0..6] and whys[0..6] already say Poppy wins every stage; the full-layer why text also described Rakan-favorable trades that contradict Poppy winning.
audit.why: The level chart token and the prose under it must name the same winner, and the why text has to actually justify that winner.
audit.corrected: Set all 7 phases[N].side to 'Poppy' and rewrite each why to ground Poppy's actual advantage (Q/E all-in, Steadfast Presence dash-block, Keeper's Verdict range/lock, late frontline).

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions flags that Poppy's Keeper's Verdict (R) has an untargetable window Rakan's Grand Entrance (R) cannot punish, and breakdown.cooldowns carries no real number.
audit.why: This is a hard counter to all-inning off your own ult and is currently absent from the page entirely.
audit.corrected: State Steadfast Presence is 20/18/16/14/12s and Keeper's Verdict is 140/120/100s, and add that Poppy can go untargetable through your R commit — wait the channel out rather than dumping your combo into it.
